gathered all of the necessary Reagents, you should Create a 
Remedy (before decreasing any Timers).
6 - Decrease Ailment Timer

33

Bartering
Little Settlements and thriving Cities dot the Bristley Woods. 
Here, beasts of all shapes and sizes work collaboratively to 
make life easier.
You can Barter in a Current or Adjacent Location containing a 
Settlement or City.
Supply and Demand
During an Ailment, you can Attempt to Barter once (1x) at 
a Settlement and three time (3x) at a City—once you start 
Haggling, regardless of outcome, the Attempt is used up.
1 - Choose a Reagent
Consult the Almanack for a single (non-Titan) Reagent Part to 
Barter for. If the Reagent Part matches any of the following 
conditions, apply its modifier to the Reagent's Base Rarity:
•	 Local (-2). Settlement-based. Can be Foraged locally.
•	 Trade Route (-2) City-based. Can be Foraged locally or 
in a Location up to 3 Paths away.
•	 In Season (-1). Is in Season.
•	 Curiosity (+2). Both out of season and not local or 
available via a Trade Route.
•	 Gourmand (+3). Can produce [FAIR] points.
•	 Highly Prized (+5). Can be Prepared to produce a [TAG 3].
•	 Why The Peck Would You Want That? (+ X). Produces 
Foul points; +[Foul] Rarity.
Friendly Donation. The Guild’s Reputation also influences 
Bartering. Decrease Reagent Rarity as follows: Unknown (+1), 
Known (0), Upstanding (-1) and Trusted (-2).
Backing Out. Some Reagents can have very high Rarities 
when Bartering—before you Wander the Streets, you can 
instead choose to go Foraging.
34

2 - Wander the Streets
Seeking your chosen Reagent, you cross paths with beasts 
going about their lives. These encounters range from kind to 
benign, to unexpectedly hostile!
Draw a card on the Social Encounter tables (page 188) — 
the Settlement/City and Current Season determine which.
3 - Finding what you Need
Draw a second card. If the Value ties or exceeds the Reagent’s 
Rarity, you Barter successfully and get the Reagent Part.
Journal about the beast you traded with and what immaterial 
object, knowledge or service you exchanged.
4- Haggling
If the second card’s value is too low, you find the needed 
Reagent Part but the owner(s) are unwilling to part with it. 
You can spend Trinkets and/or Reputation to make up the 
difference or leave empty-pawed.
Journal about the beast you traded with, and what Trinkets 
you traded, Guild vows you made or social obligations you 
called on to make this deal work.
5- Decrease Timer
After completing your Barter attempt, if you have the 
necessary Reagents, start Creating a Remedy. 
Otherwise, reduce Timers by 1.
If all Timers reach 0, you should Prepare To Leave.
If any Timer is at least 1: Continue Foraging or Bartering, 
accruing Foraging Points and completing Encounters.
35

Preparing to Leave
Once you have concluded your business (or Overstayed Your 
Welcome), Prepare to Leave. Set your Foraging Points to 0 
and complete the relevant actions on this list.
Overstaying Your Welcome
If all your Timers reached 0 and you failed to create any 
Remedies for any Ailments, you have Overstayed Your Welcome.
Face the Consequences of all unsolved Ailments and then 
immediately Move On.
1 - Providing Remedies
If you created a Remedy for your patient’s Ailment, they 
reward your hard work with Trinkets.
Trading. Gain +1 Trinket per Ailment Severity level, +1 Trinket 
for every 2 [Fair], and -1 Trinket for every 2 [Foul]. Foul and Fair 
cancel each other.  You always receive at least 0 Trinkets.
Gifting. You can refuse payment, gaining +2 Guild Reputation 
instead. You can’t do this if you are receiving 0 Trinkets!
2 - Building Rapport
Resolving an Ailment with a Remedy grants +1 Reputation per 
Severity. E.G a Serious Ailment grants +3 Guild Reputation.
3 - Resolving Outcomes
Some Ailments have optional Outcomes. If you create 
a Remedy matching an Outcome’s criteria, follow its 
instructions.
36

These are all of the Tools you can 
collect on your travels. They have 
special rules (such as how they help 
you, how much they weigh, and if they 
can be found in specific places).

103

Monthly Chore
Lesser  -  i 6 
[scales 2, pain 1]
This lizard is rubbing up against every 
hard surface they can find to soothe 
the itching of their scales. It’s almost 
time for them to shed, but if they can’t 
find a way of soothing it soon they may 
rub the new skin underneath raw.	
Consequence - Dandruff 
There are flakes of dead skin 
everywhere, and the lizard is too sore to 
clean up. You can stay and help clean; 
Mark 1 Day, and lose no Reputation.
Nervefright
Lesser       -      i 9 
[instinct 3, nerves 3, mood 3]
A close call with a Behemoth has left 
this poor beast frozen in fright. Their 
instincts won't let them move and they 
won't respond to anyone.	
Consequence - Heart Attack 
The stress is too much and their heart 
gives out. Who is the Behemoth who 
caused this? Use the rules on page 40 
to mark their Barrow on the Map. 
Night Shift
Intermediate  -  i 6 
[sleep 3, mood 2]
This beast has been honing a special 
craft, culminating in their Magnum 
Opus. They can't work during their 
normal waking hours because of their 
roommates conflicting sleep schedules, 
and so have been going without sleep. 
They're delirious, and desperate to 
finish their project.
Outcome - Credits 
What is their magnum opus? If you can 
cure them in time, they will make a 
dedication on their creation to you.	
Consequence - Sleeping on the Job 
They fall asleep while working on their 
special project, and ruin it completely.
Paw Rot
lesser  -  i 9 
[infection 1 & pain 1]
After walking one too many days on 
sodden soil, the webbing in-between 
this beast's feet are itchy and swollen. 
Something applied regularly every day 
for a few weeks should clear it up…	
Outcome - Squeaky Clean 
If the remedy is PRESERVED - with 
this long-lasting unguent, this 
infection can be treated reliably when 
it shows up again. 
Next time you come through this location, 
gain 1 trinket from a grateful patient.
Consequence - Trodden In 
While a minor issue on its own, this 
beast is rather popular. Who else have 
they spread their Paw Rot to? 
The next time you visit this location, 
the only ailment you can try to resolve 
is Paw Rot.

conclusions.finding: Canvas Tent=2 whole Weight circles; Big Iron Cauldron=2; Bark Coracle=3. Existing canonical weights agree; no engine edit.
Check gathered Reagents and create remedy before reducing Timer. Prepared UI branch holds Timer at3; cancels and reloads safely.
Lesser/FAIR0/FOUL0 gives1Trinket and1Reputation; actual UI confirms. Exploratory +2 guess was replaced only after checking this primary source; engine unchanged.
Monthly Chore requires SCALE2 and PAIN1. Prepared UI branch displays these values.

Nervefright appears in Severe table, while p110 labels individual entry Lesser. Existing KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md already documents this source conflict; preserve table-based policy and do not invent an erratum.
